Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
8:34 PM

The National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is closed on Mondays and national holidays. It's open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Tomorrow, Fri 13 Nov, it opens at 10:00 AM.

Tickets

Adults (Indian visitors): ₹20
Foreign nationals: ₹500
Students up to class 12: free, with an I-card

The museum's site lists online booking at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. I haven't booked anything. The page doesn't show when it was last updated, so check its holiday calendar before you go.
